query:
SELECT a.id, 
  JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(a.cost_intelligence_json, 'one', '$.compositeOptimisation') as has_composite,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation') IS NOT NULL as composite_not_null,
  JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.lineItems')) as line_items_count
FROM ai_assessments a ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 3;
